citation: Texts show Rep. Tony Gonzales asked for explicit photos from aide who later died by suicide
title: Texts show Rep. Tony Gonzales asked for explicit photos from aide who later died by suicide
notes: The earliest capture, 15 minutes after the dateline (Feb. 23, 2026, 3:31 p.m. Central). The Tribune later revised the sourcing sentence, with no correction note and no change to dateModified (2026-02-23T15:31:10-06:00): this copy says the aide's husband "released these text messages to the San Antonio Express-News over the weekend"; the page as served on 2026-10-14 says he "shared these text messages with The Texas Tribune on Monday" and that he told "the San Antonio Express-News, which published the text messages first".
